config_file_text:
paths:
  output_dir: "/data2/jt577/2026/09.2026/blob_EAT/09.30/runs_12_slice_gaussian_320_imagepenalty=10"
  # Optional prior structures.json: seed generation 0, then normal selection.
  import_structures_json: ""

model:
  mp_api_key: ""
  model_name: "uma-s-1p1"
  task_name: "omat"

system:
  # FairChem remains xyz periodic. Add 8 A of vacuum on each side of XYZ;
  # XY padding is snapped to whole pixels. Padding is excluded from image loss.
  vacuum_padding_angstrom: "8.0, 8.0, 8.0"
  pbc: "true, true, true"
  species: "W, Se"

experimental:
  tiff_file: "/data2/jt577/2026/08.2026/blob_EAT/08.24/objp_zstack_iter0200.tif"
  crop_xy_size_source_pixels: 320
  target_xy_pixels: 320
  target_z_slices: 12
  source_voxel_size_angstrom: "1.0, 0.152564, 0.152564"
  # Subtract this background percentile, clip negatives, then normalize.
  target_background_percentile: 1.0
  target_normalization_percentile: 99.5

feasible_region:
  mask_smoothing_sigma_pixels: "0.5, 1.0, 1.0"
  threshold_mode: "percentile"
  threshold: 50.0
  level_set_margin_angstrom: 0.0
  boundary_penalty: 0.0
  boundary_sharpness: 8.0

sample_box:
  # Atomic slab in TIFF coordinates, independent of optional added z padding.
  # Bounds translate into cell coordinates automatically when padding changes.
  z_min_angstrom: 0.0
  z_max_angstrom: 12.0
  confinement_penalty: 50.0
  confinement_sharpness: 8.0
  confinement_margin_angstrom: 0.0

imaging:
  shared_sigma_z_angstrom: 4.0
  # All 12 measured slices contribute; synthetic XY/Z padding is masked out.
  penalty: 10.0
  huber_delta: 0.20
  target_transform: "linear"
  transform_epsilon: 1.0e-6
  epsilon: 1.0e-12
  relative_intensity_reference_species: "W"
  normalize_relative_intensity_reference_peak_to_one: true
  clip_experimental_to_unit_interval: false
  additional_lateral_blur_angstrom: 0.08

random_immigrant_image_prefit:
  enable: true
  initial_occupancy_mode: "uniform"
  initial_logit_noise: 0.20
  soft_steps: 500
  # Rounding and fixed-species position relaxation happen only after the
  # normal energy-inclusive syntropization, not inside this image prefit.
  final_position_steps: 0
  position_learning_rate: 0.025
  occupancy_learning_rate: 0.07
  entropy_final_weight: 1.0
  repulsion_weight: 2.0
  minimum_distance_angstrom: 1.0
  composition_penalty_enable: true
  # Preserve every soft candidate site until syntropization has rounded.
  compact_null_sites_before_fairchem: false

diagnostics:
  initial_diagnostics_enable: true
  exit_after_initial_diagnostics: false
  max_isosurface_points: 60000
  member_slice_comparisons_enable: false

effective_atoms:
  # Candidate count is based on the unpadded feasible sample volume only.
  candidate_site_density_per_angstrom3: 0.20
  initial_cylinder_lateral_radius_angstrom: 0.75
  initial_cylinder_z_radius_angstrom: 3.0
  initial_jitter_angstrom: 0.10

composition:
  composition_target: "1, 2"
  composition_penalty: 10.0
  exact_composition_enforcement_enable: false

se_vacancy_bias:
  # Keep the optional vacancy bias disabled for the Gaussian image run.
  # Retain the calibrated values below for possible controlled future tests.
  enable: false
  alpha_eV_per_vacancy: 1.8353
  reference_atom_count: 350.0

syntropization:
  tsallis_q: 2.0
  beta0: 1.0e-3
  beta_mult: 1.5
  beta_max_stages: 0
  entropy_stop_avg: 1.0e-3
  binary_stop_maxmin: 1.0e-3
  also_require_binary_stop: false

minimizer:
  maxit: 100
  tol: 3e-2
  bfgs_hist: 8
  max_line_search: 10
  stage_stagnation_patience: 5
  stage_stagnation_min_improvement: 3.0e-3
  final_pbfgs_enable: true
  final_pbfgs_maxit: 500
  final_pbfgs_tol: 3.0e-3
  final_pbfgs_cost_plateau_tol: 3.0e-4
  final_pbfgs_cost_plateau_patience: 10
  final_pbfgs_cost_plateau_min_iterations: 50

initialization:
  init_occ_total: 0.30
  init_occ_noise: 0.05
  init_species_mode: "dirichlet"
  init_species_dirichlet_alpha: 5.0
  keep_thresh: 1.0e-3
  seed: null

history:
  disable_trajectory_history: true
  history_every: 1

runtime:
  terminal_verbose: false
  heartbeat_interval_seconds: 60.0
  running_log_file: ""
  local_resource_log_interval_seconds: 60.0
  worker_health_check_interval_seconds: 10.0

checkpointing:
  member_progress_enable: true
  member_progress_interval_iterations: 10
  member_progress_interval_seconds: 60.0
  retain_completed_member_checkpoints: false

genetic:
  enable: true
  population_size: 50
  # Total limit; restart the same command to extend the existing checkpoint.
  generations: 200
  elite_fraction: 0.10
  random_fraction: 0.25
  crossover_fraction: 0.65
  # Parent + a completed random immigrant from this generation; reuses crossover/EAT.
  mutation_fraction: 0.0
  parent_pool_size: 50
  # Set n > 0 to import the best n records; fill remaining population slots randomly.
  # No deduplication. With a nonempty import path, 0 retains the legacy auto count.
  import_parent_count: 0
  crossover_pos_sigma: 0.25
  crossover_occ_sigma: 0.05
  crossover_species_sigma: 0.25
  parent_a_tournament_size: 4 # Parent A is the lowest-score member sampled by tournament A.
  parent_b_tournament_size: 2 # Parent B is the lowest-score member sampled after excluding parent A.
  diversity_subcells: "12, 12, 4" # Legacy-compatible parsed setting; crossover parent selection and alignment no longer use subcell diversity.
  # The cell remains periodic in z; only the z translation search is disabled
  # because the sample is anchored between explicit vacuum regions.
  superposition_occ_scale: 0.50
  superposition_prune_distance_angstrom: 1.0
  superposition_prune_occ_thresh: 1.0e-3
  live_plot_enable: true
  live_plot_file: ""
  live_plot_metric: "score"
  live_plot_alpha: 0.45
  live_plot_jitter: 0.16
  parallel_workers: 1
  parallel_gpu_ids: "0"
  execution_backend: "local"
  log_file: ""
  score: "guided"
